scripts.app:icon: node scripts/appIcon.mjs && tauri icon src-tauri/app-icon.png && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/android src-tauri/icons/ios
scripts.ai:setup: python3 -m venv tests/ai/.venv && tests/ai/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r tests/ai/requirements.txt

scripts-info.dev: Starts the game in the browser while developing (Vite, reloads on save).
scripts-info.build: Type-checks, then builds the game for release into dist/.
scripts-info.preview: Serves the built game from dist/, to try it as released.
scripts-info.app: Builds the desktop app (Tauri; needs Rust): EvenHold.app and its .dmg, in src-tauri/target/release/bundle/.
scripts-info.app:dev: Opens the game in its desktop window while developing (reloads on save).
scripts-info.app:icon: Redraws the app's icon (scripts/appIcon.mjs) and makes every size of it.
scripts-info.player: A player of their own mind plays an hour of a fresh game, told as it goes; a report to read the game by in tests/bots/reports/play-….md (PLAY_SEED to play one again, PLAY_MINUTES for longer, PLAYERS=4 for up to four at once, PLAY_SEEDS=a,b,c for several again).
scripts-info.ai:setup: Sets up the AI player's training (tests/ai/): a Python environment of its own, tests/ai/.venv, with PyTorch, Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium.
scripts-info.ai:train: Trains an AI to play the whole game from nothing (PPO, on all but one core), knowing the keys and seeing the screen, paid for the game's own progress: a million decisions more, on from the player saved (a fresh one if there's none); -- --steps n for more, -- --fresh to start over. Writes tests/ai/models/ (the player, and lives.jsonl: each life's tally).
scripts-info.ai:play: The trained AI plays a life (AI_SEED, AI_MINUTES; none trained: keys at random), told as it goes; a report of what it did and skipped in tests/ai/reports/ai-….md.
scripts-info.ai:watch: Opens the game in the browser, the trained AI playing it live in the game's own view (?seed=n that world, ?random keys at random): what it presses lit below, the window it reads beside; space pause, 1/2/4/8/16 speed, N a new life.
scripts-info.(settings): Any bots script takes: BOTS=n (how many), BOT_MINUTES=n (game minutes each), BOT_CLASSIC=1 (an older game's 2048 world, else a new game's streamed 16384 one), BOT_SEEDS=a,b (play those games again, exactly), BOT_FIRST_SEED=n (seeds n, n+1…), BOT_VERBOSE=1 (live), e.g. BOT_SEEDS=123 npm run bots:verbose.
